CustomField.description: Long-lived User access token obtained by the "Connect to Meta" embedded Facebook Login flow (MetaOAuthConnectService). Used ONLY by that flow's own Page/Form auto-discovery — separate from and never read by the Named Credential-based lead-capture pipeline (MetaLeadFetchQueueable, MetaConversionSyncQueueable, MetaPageSyncService, MetaFormSyncService), which keeps using its own System User token. Never exposed to the client — Apex-only.
CustomField.label: Meta User Access Token
